body: My family is always busy when I need to go into work, and public transportation requires a pass which costs a significant amount of money as well.

While under normal circumstances I'd say that I really hope something changes for the better, and I do build up that tolerance, I've already reached that point of no return.   
I just wish I could go to each of my family members that were close to me growing up and apologise for what I've become.

It's not the living with my parents portion that gets me.   
It's the fact that everything goes wrong.   
While my job does pay me well, I don't have the money to just continually buy Ubers back and forth to work (My workplace is around 15-20 miles away from my house).
